content:
Nina (partnerships): Spinning up a short triage for marketplace listing preflight across AWS/GCP/Azure. Focus: legal artifacts, packaging SKU mapping, and cert/KMS responsibilities.

listing-bot: Preflight checklist: publisher account, offer metadata, pricing JSON, assets, legal docs. https://portal.redwood.example/marketplace/preflight :white_check_mark:

Omar (cloud-eng): I'll do the cloud infra bits. For AWS we prefer cross-account role 'redwood-marketplace-role' and an S3 bucket for assets with least privilege.

Tess (product): SKU mapping thought: create base SKU 'hosted-api' with meter "tokens" and add-on SKU 'dedicated-reserved' which bills monthly. Trial SKU = hosted-api-trial with 14d entitlement.

Maya (solutions): Metering question: Azure marketplace sometimes only supports resource-based metering. We should standardize telemetry to 'tokens_consumed' event so we can transform per-platform.

Kevin (legal): Need to confirm whether publisher onboarding requires an indemnity acknowledgement in the portal. Also flag export controls for certain models. I'll add notes.

Nina (partnerships): Omar - any required DNS validation steps for certs?

Omar (cloud-eng): Yes: ACM for AWS needs CNAME records for domain validation unless we use DNS-validated cert via Route53. For Azure App Service/KeyVault we need validation TXT/CNAME too. We'll include a CNAME template.

Tess (product): Marketing assets: we need a short 'how it works' with network boundaries and an example curl. Also confirm screenshots for console workflow.

Maya (solutions): We'll provide a small SDK snippet for metering reporting. Recommend batching events on 1-min intervals.

Kevin (legal): Drafted a short clause: 'Customer consents to marketplace billing; Redwood reserves right to audit transaction records on reasonable notice.' Sharing for review.

Nina (partnerships): Action items: Omar: Terraform + CNAME templates; Tess: SKU/price JSON draft; Kevin: clause + export control note; Maya: metering SDK sample. Target: ship preflight doc by tomorrow lunchtime.

listing-bot: publish:preflight-doc-ready -> link:/shelf/preflight/1765432109 :bookmark_tabs:

Omar (cloud-eng): I'll drop Terraform snippet here once I finish.

Tess (product): Will share pricing grid in 2 hours.

Kevin (legal): Will review pricing and return comments.

Nina (partnerships): Great. Schedule a 30m sync post-doc publication. :calendar:
